# SequenceArchitectureTransfer

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The reuse of compact sequence architectures discovered for one task as initial seeds for evolving solutions to related sequence tasks, leveraging shared structural priors. Reduces search time and hardware adaptation effort when deploying TCC/iNEST systems across multiple sequence-processing workloads in dynamic network environments.
